title: Gallaudet visits Skinwalker Ranch with Brandon Fugal

tellings.quote: So we went out and we had this great day together.

plain: A Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet tells Michels that he went out to Skinwalker Ranch, a ranch in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, with a man named Brandon Fugal. Gallaudet speaks of it as his own visit and says only that it went well: "So we went out and we had this great day together."
